purpose: Historical continuation archive; not the active product or deployment root.
path_convention: source is relative to its source_root (default session); destination is relative to the handoff repository root.
hash_convention: source_sha256 hashes the original source bytes; sha256 hashes the preserved, possibly sanitized bytes; excluded files and excluded directory trees are deliberately not read or hashed.

security_review.raw_session_records: Excluded, including SESSION files, command/browser dumps and screenshots.
security_review.credentials: Environment and credential files excluded. Retained UTF-8 text scanned for private keys, known service tokens, credential URLs, bearer/JWT tokens and credential assignments. Additional assignment and query-token review performed.
security_review.limitations: Pattern-based scan and targeted review, not a guarantee that all sensitive content can be identified automatically. Historical runtime configuration is omitted.

exclusion_scope: A source entry ending with / excludes that complete directory tree. Counts represent inventory entries, not the contents of skipped directory trees.
